description: Verified research starting points, not qualified leads. Verify current ownership, vacancies, geography, size and willingness to use a recruiting partner. User overrides live in hr_ops.discovery.sources.

sources.name: River
sources.notes: Official careers URL redirects to this board. Review each job for LATAM eligibility; direct international hiring does not establish agency demand.

identity_evidence.excerpt: The official River careers URL redirects to jobs.ashbyhq.com/river.

sources.name: Railway
sources.notes: Official careers page lists engineering openings and global work. Verify current roles, internal recruiting resources and a specific service-fit hypothesis.

identity_evidence.excerpt: Railway publishes its current engineering openings on its own careers page.

sources.name: Perry Street Software
sources.notes: Official page links to Zoho Recruit. Existing South America hiring is a compatibility signal, not evidence of needing an agency.

identity_evidence.excerpt: Perry Street Software's careers page links to its Zoho Recruit openings.

sources.name: Redfish Technology
sources.notes: Board attributes roles to clients. Many roles are U.S.-restricted; verify individual locations and client openness to LATAM. Recruiter count and LATAM specialization require separate evidence.

identity_evidence.excerpt: Redfish Technology publishes client engineering vacancies on its own job board.

sources.name: hatch I.T.
sources.notes: Official site links to hatchpad jobs. Inspect employer attribution and geography: mission/defense roles may impose citizenship, clearance or onsite restrictions.

identity_evidence.excerpt: The official hatch I.T. website links to www.myhatchpad.com/jobs/.

sources.name: Recruiting from Scratch
sources.notes: Already recruits in LATAM. Included for overlap review, not preferred qualification. Referral program is not evidence of delivery subcontracting demand. Specialization remains a separate question.

identity_evidence.excerpt: Recruiting from Scratch publishes a jobs page for its recruiting searches.
